name: Button
summary: Action trigger for primary, secondary, and destructive user actions.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual intent. Use danger only for destructive actions.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. Use specific action text.

examples.name: Destructive confirm action
examples.description: Use inside a confirmation dialog for destructive actions.
examples.code:
import { Button } from "@acme/ui/button";

<Button variant="danger" size="md">Delete project</Button>

examples.name: Primary action
examples.code:
import { Button } from "@acme/ui/button";

<Button variant="primary" size="md">Save changes</Button>

constraints.message: Button labels must name the action and object; avoid vague labels such as Submit.
constraints.rationale: Specific labels support clarity and accessibility.

constraints.message: Use variant=danger only for destructive or irreversible actions.
